description: Ask SNTL one research question about a space company or market, and choose the product. answer (€5 to 31 December 2026, then €10): accepted or declined automatically. brief (€250, two to five pages) or map (€999, a segment mapped): SNTL accepts or declines the scope; on acceptance a fixed-price quote follows; delivered within 7 (brief) or 14 (map) days of payment. Nothing is owed until payment. Keep the receipt and return with check_research_status. Collection notice: https://sntl.space/enquiry-privacy. Do not include contact details or personal information.

budget.description: Optional: what you are prepared to spend, in minor units (cents) with a three-letter currency code. Prices are fixed by product.

companyName.description: The company the question is about, when subjectType is space_company.

consentToStore.description: Must be true: SNTL stores the request to answer it. Collection notice: https://sntl.space/enquiry-privacy.

maximumAgeDays.description: How recent the sources must be, in days (0 to 3,650).

outputFormat.description: The form of the reply, whichever product you choose.

product.description: What you are buying: answer (one question, answered with cited sources), brief (two to five pages) or map (a segment mapped). Optional; without it the request is an answer, priced as one.

question.description: Your research question, 10 to 2,000 characters. Do not include contact details or personal information.

subjectType.description: space_company for a question about one company; space_market for a market, segment or trend.

topics.description: Up to five short topics that narrow the question, for example launch or earth observation.

name: submit_research_interest
title: Ask SNTL a research question
